title: Facile assembly of flexible humidity sensors based on nanostructured graphite/zinc oxide-coated cellulose fibrous frameworks for human healthcare
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,37570-37579
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05761A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zaka Ullah, Ghulam M. Mustafa, Ali Raza, Adnan Khalil, Aboud Ahmed Awadh Bahajjaj, Rashida Batool, Nazmina Imrose Sonil, Irfan Ali, Muhammad Faizan Nazar
The work presents the assembly of a flexible humidity sensor based on graphite/ZnO-NPs coating on cellulose paper. The sensor shows high sensitivity and a short response time. It offers notable potential for human breath monitoring.
